test_series_sort_values: test the Series.sort_values method to sort by values with ascending, descending, and na_position options
test_series_sort_values_categorical: test the Series.sort_values method on categorical data with ordered and unordered categories
test_series_sort_values_ignore_index: test the Series.sort_values method with ignore_index and inplace parameters to control index and mutation behavior
test_series_sort_values_mergesort_stabil: test the Series.sort_values method with kind=mergesort to verify stable descending sort preserves original order
test_series_sort_values_key: test the Series.sort_values method with a key function to apply custom transformation before sorting
